messages:
alex.p: Quick sync — ConcordAI (open checkpoint) onboarding: legal wants distro terms before we push to the cloud marketplaces. Can product/marketing lock an announcement window that matches legal's conditions?

maria.l: yep, we need the rehosting & redistribution language finalized. primary ask: add a non-exclusive redistribution clause + attribution + no commercial sublicensing without explicit permission. also confirm whether weights can be rehosted by SI partners.

sophie.legal: Draft clause I recommend (super-short): 



`Partners may redistribute and host model weights on their own infra or marketplace offerings under a non-exclusive redistribution license provided they: (a) preserve the model attribution notice; (b) do not relicense the model under more permissive terms; (c) do not embed the model in a product that provides the weights as a standalone downloadable file for resale. Commercial sublicensing requires written approval from Redwood and the upstream model maintainer.`

sophie.legal: We should confirm upstream licensor allows rehosting — Concord's repo uses a permissive BSD-style header but we still need the contributor addendum signed.

jordan.eng: Technical note: if SIs rehost quantized variants we ship, need a checksum/versioning scheme so we can trace back results in case of quality/regression reports. Short idea: tag artifacts with `redwood-concord-v{semver}+quant{type}+build{sha}`.

ravi.hw: For HW partners (EdgeBox and RackTitan) — we need to confirm supported quant formats (int8, awq, q4_v2). If marketplace bundles include optimized kernels, we must ensure the model license permits derivative binaries. That ties into Sophie’s sublicensing caveat.

priya.gm: Announcement asks: marketing wants a 2-week embargo pre-announce for partner readiness. Proposed cadence: legal sign-off day = D, engineering readiness check D+3, SI integration smoke test complete D+7, partner marketplace listing D+10, public announce D+14. Thoughts? :calendar:

sam.sales: Sales input: some enterprise partners want exclusive co-marketing windows in specific regions for 30 days. That conflicts with non-exclusive distro language. We can offer go-to-market exclusives (pricing/placement) but not exclusive redistribution rights. Need to be explicit in partner MSA.

alex.p: Good call — keep distro non-exclusive, but allow limited GTM exclusivity (placement/promo) via separate commercial addendum. Sophie, can legal draft two short addenda: (1) GTM exclusivity (timeboxed), (2) SI/reseller onboarding checklist that calls out allowed rehost/quant formats and attribution?

sophie.legal: Yes. I can draft both. For the SI checklist I'll include: required artifact tagging, a prohibition on repackaging weights as a resellable product, audit logging obligation for the first 90 days after listing, and a takedown process.

jordan.eng: Also add a technical rollback path: if we detect a widespread quality regression from a partner-hosted variant, we need the right to request a temporary delist until remediation. That should be short, ~48-72h to fix.

sophie.legal: Put that in. I'll add a remediation SLA and delist clause.

priya.gm: Marketing: can we get a final one-paragraph approved by legal that we can put into the partner listing blurb? Need it for the cloud marketplaces which enforce strict listing copy.

sophie.legal: I'll write a 1-2 sentence approved blurb: "ConcordAI (via Redwood Inference) is available for redistribution under a non-exclusive license; partners must follow attribution and audit requirements. Contact partnerships@redwood.ai for commercial GTM terms."

ravi.hw: For operational compatibility, flag: EdgeBox needs `libcuda` compatibility for our kernel bundle; RackTitan expects an `x86-avx512` optimized binary. Engineering, can you prepare 2 kernel bundles and a compatibility matrix for marketplace assets?

jordan.eng: Yep. We'll produce `kernel-edgebox.tar.gz` (cuda) and `kernel-racktitan.tar.gz` (avx512). Will also include a `compat.json` with CPU/GPU/quant supported combos. Example snippet: 

```
{
  "artifact_tag": "redwood-concord-v1.2+quant-q4_v2+buildabcd123",
  "supported_backends": ["cuda11.8-cuquant","avx512-q4_v2"],
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

alex.p: Perfect. Next: announcements — Priya will sync with partners for embargo windows. Sam, coordinate with top 3 enterprise partners for any GTM exclusivity requests; flag conflicts by EOD Friday.

sam.sales: On it. Will ping EdgeBox, RackTitan, and CloudWave.

priya.gm: I'll draft a partner-facing timeline and attach Sophie’s blurb. Need legal and eng sign-off by Wed COB.

release-bot: Deployed checklist v0.3 to /internal/partner-assets — includes `artifact_tag` template and sample `compat.json`. :package:

alex.p: Thanks everyone. Action items (summary):
- Sophie: draft distro clause + GTM addendum + SI checklist + one-paragraph blurb (due Wed COB)
- Jordan: produce kernel bundles + compat.json + tagging scheme (due Tue)
- Ravi: confirm HW partner format compat and list any blockers (due Tue)
- Priya: partner timeline + embargo coordination (due Wed COB)
- Sam: surface exclusivity asks from top 3 partners (due Fri EOD)

alex.p: If no objections I'll mark this thread as the source of truth and we'll attach final docs to the marketplace listing PR. :thumbsup:

maria.l: No objections from legal side, just flag the upstream concord contributor addendum sign-off.

alex.p: Noted. Thanks all!
